sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 27B Qwen3.8 27B is a compact, deployment-friendly dense vision-language model built on the Qwen3.5 architecture. It delivers stronger performance across coding, professional work, research, and long-horizon agentic tasks. Highlights Agent Execution: stronger autonomous planning and environment-feedback handling improve reliability on complex, multi-step tasks. Flexible Thinking Control ...

sources.title: Run Qwen 3.8 27B on AMD Ryzen™ AI Max Agentic PCs and Radeon ™ GPUs
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 27B brings the latest generation of the Qwen family to a model size well suited for local AI development. The Qwen 3.8 generation continues the focus on coding, real-world work, research, and long-horizon AI workloads, extending the rapid pace of innovation we are seeing across open AI.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B — Benchmarks, Specs & Release Date
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B is an AI model released by Qwen on Friday, Aug 14 2026, 11 days after Qwen3.8-Max. It is an open-weight model — the trained weights are available to download and run.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B: Runs Locally, Nears Claude Opus (Aug 2026) - explainx.ai
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B is the direct successor to Qwen 3.6 27B, which our earlier hands-on coverage found to be the local coding sweet spot — better agent output than the sparser Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, if noticeably slower. sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B is a dense 27B vision-language model for coding, professional work, research, and long-horizon agentic tasks, with configurable reasoning and a native 262K-token context window.
